label: Resistivity and sheet resistance
subgoals: Convert the resistivity to ohm metres
Divide by the layer thickness to get sheet resistance
Report the result in ohm per square

label: Counting squares
subgoals: Divide the wire length by its width to count squares
Multiply the square count by the sheet resistance
Scale the result inversely with any change of width

label: Vias and parallel paths
subgoals: Compute each layer segment's resistance from its squares
Divide the via resistance by the number of parallel cuts
Add the series segments and via arrays for the total
